label: Energy, utilities, and critical-infrastructure estate
domain: electricity, gas, water, pipelines, utilities, grid interconnection, public commissions, infrastructure finance, and large-load demand
jurisdictions: United States federal and state jurisdictions
scope: Regulated utilities, generators, transmission, pipelines, water systems, public utility commissions, FERC dockets, interconnection queues, rate cases, large-load and data-center demand, infrastructure finance, reliability, public subsidies, and ownership. The estate preserves docket, facility, utility, customer, capacity, rate, approval, construction, and operational dates.

asset_refs.role: bounded frontier survey and acquisition preparation

boundary: A proposed project, queue position, rate filing, approval, financing, construction milestone, and operating asset are different states. Shared grid geography is not a relationship.

next_acquisition.operation: join facilities, utilities, dockets, rate instruments, capacity, ownership, public support, construction, and operation
next_acquisition.decisive_output: facility- and docket-level ledger of legal owner, utility, interconnection, load or capacity, rate treatment, approval, subsidy, construction, operation, and cancellation controls
